options.name: Psychic Drain
options.description: One creature charmed by the aboleth takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage, and the aboleth regains hit points equal to the damage the creature takes.

options.name: Claw Attack
options.description: The sphinx makes one claw attack.

options.name: Teleport
options.description: The sphinx magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

options.name: Cast a Spell
options.description: The sphinx casts a spell from its list of prepared spells, using a spell slot as normal.

options.name: Cast a Spell
options.description: The sphinx casts a spell from its list of prepared spells, using a spell slot as normal.

options.name: Tentacle Attack or Fling
options.description: The kraken makes one tentacle attack or uses its Fling.

options.name: Lightning Storm
options.description: The kraken uses Lightning Storm.

options.name: Ink Cloud
options.description: While underwater, the kraken expels an ink cloud in a 60-foot radius. The cloud spreads around corners, and that area is heavily obscured to creatures other than the kraken. Each creature other than the kraken that ends its turn there must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw, taking 16 (3d10) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A strong current disperses the cloud, which otherwise disappears at the end of the kraken's next turn.

options.name: Cantrip
options.description: The lich casts a cantrip.

options.name: Paralyzing Touch
options.description: The lich uses its Paralyzing Touch.

options.name: Frightening Gaze
options.description: The lich fixes its gaze on one creature it can see within 10 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or become frightened for 1 minute. The frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to the lich's gaze for the next 24 hours.

options.name: Disrupt Life
options.description: Each non-undead creature within 20 feet of the lich must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw against this magic, taking 21 (6d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

options.name: Attack
options.description: The mummy lord makes one attack with its rotting fist or uses its Dreadful Glare.

options.name: Blinding Dust
options.description: Blinding dust and sand swirls magically around the mummy lord. Each creature within 5 feet of the mummy lord must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of the creature's next turn.

options.name: Blasphemous Word
options.description: The mummy lord utters a blasphemous word. Each non-undead creature within 10 feet of the mummy lord that can hear the magical utterance must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the mummy lord's next turn.

options.name: Channel Negative Energy
options.description: The mummy lord magically unleashes negative energy. Creatures within 60 feet of the mummy lord, including ones behind barriers and around corners, can't regain hit points until the end of the mummy lord's next turn.

options.name: Whirlwind of Sand
options.description: The mummy lord magically transforms into a whirlwind of sand, moves up to 60 feet, and reverts to its normal form. While in whirlwind form, the mummy lord is immune to all damage, and it can't be grappled, petrified, knocked prone, restrained, or stunned. Equipment worn or carried by the mummy lord remain in its possession.

options.name: Teleport
options.description: The solar magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

options.name: Searing Burst
options.description: The solar emits magical, divine energy. Each creature of its choice in a 10-foot radius must make a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) fire damage plus 14 (4d6) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

options.name: Blinding Gaze
options.description: The solar targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see it, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until magic such as the *lesser restoration* spell removes the blindness.

options.name: Attack
options.description: The tarrasque makes one claw attack or tail attack.

options.name: Move
options.description: The tarrasque moves up to half its speed.

options.name: Chomp
options.description: The tarrasque makes one bite attack or uses its Swallow.

options.name: Hooves
options.description: The unicorn makes one attack with its hooves.

options.name: Shimmering Shield
options.description: The unicorn creates a shimmering, magical field around itself or another creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target gains a +2 bonus to AC until the end of the unicorn's next turn.

options.name: Heal Self
options.description: The unicorn magically regains 11 (2d8 + 2) hit points.

options.name: Move
options.description: The vampire moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

options.name: Unarmed Strike
options.description: The vampire makes one unarmed strike.

options.name: Bite
options.description: The vampire makes one bite attack.
